topic: How does the 41% efficiency of the proposed antenna impact link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links?
consensus_response: The 41% efficiency of the antenna impacts link budget calculations for GEO-LEO satellite links by necessitating higher transmitted power to maintain the same (C/N0) values, which can lead to increased operational costs and network costs. The reduced gain also amplifies interference from other sources, which can affect network capacity, potentially limiting the number of active satellites due to power constraints. To mitigate these effects, network management strategies such as dynamic resource allocation, interference mitigation techniques, and adaptive modulation schemes can be employed to optimize network performance while minimizing operational costs.
